mood: Poetic, calm, sensory, editorial magazine lifestyle

primary.description: Cream/Ivoire, main background, soft and natural.

secondary.description: Dark brown, used for text on light backgrounds and background for dark sections.

accent.description: Terracotta, used for highlights, CTA buttons, and specific emphasis blocks.

strategies.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-8xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-none italic

rules: Headings should heavily utilize italics for an editorial, magazine-like feel.
Use massive font sizes for quotes and primary hero texts to create impact.

spacing_and_layout.padding: Use p-12, p-16, p-24, and p-32 for sections to give an airy, luxurious feel.
spacing_and_layout.grid: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetrical layouts mixing large images and small text blocks. 12-column grid on desktop.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Center align hero text, left align body paragraphs.

navbar.style: Transparent on top, smoothly transitions to bg-[#3b312b] on scroll.
navbar.elements: Large white serif text logo ('Plume Suites'), Language switch (FR/EN), Burger menu (mobile), 'Réserver' button (Smoobu integration).

hero.text: Giant serif title, center aligned, poetic vibe.

buttons.primary: bg-[#b9785d] text-white hover:bg-[#a66a51] transition-colors px-6 py-3 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest text-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#3b312b] text-[#3b312b] hover:bg-[#3b312b] hover:text-[#f5f1ea] transition-colors px-6 py-3 rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest text-sm

sections: Art de Vivre Bento Grid (4 blocks: Gastronomie, Canal, Villages/Vignobles, Slow moments)
Fullscreen Citation (Terracotta or Dark Brown bg)

hero_landscape.description: Serene countryside landscape at golden hour, misty hills, a calm river, elegant atmosphere.

suite_douceur.description: Luxury boutique hotel bedroom interior, warm cream and terracotta tones.

suite_envolee.description: Airy, elegant boutique hotel suite interior, high ceilings, large arched windows.

lifestyle_reading.description: Woman in linen dress reading a book, warm sunlight, beige and earthy tones.

bourgogne_canal.description: Burgundy Canal in France, calm water reflecting tall trees, misty morning.

vineyard_bourgogne.description: Sunny vineyard in Burgundy France, terracotta and green colors.

costa_del_sol.description: Sunny coastal view with palm trees, representing the future Costa del Sol location.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images should have a subtle slow scale effect (scale-105 duration-700) on hover. Buttons should change background colors smoothly.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Implement parallax effects on fullscreen images.
motion_and_interactions.reveal: Fade in text block by block as the user scrolls down (staggered animations).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'framer-motion' for scroll and hover animations.
Use Tailwind configuration to map the exact colors provided.
Load 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' fonts from Google Fonts.
Ensure the layout feels like a high-end print magazine (use the 'Tetris' bento grid rules).
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements (links, buttons, form inputs).
Build a dynamic Navigation bar that is transparent on top and turns dark brown (#3b312b) on scroll.
Implement routing for all requested pages (/, /art-de-vivre, /sejours, /sejours/douceur, /sejours/envolee, /journal, /journal/[slug], /contact).
DO NOT use placeholder images; rely strictly on the provided image URLs in this JSON.
